IS 2986 : 1990 Steel castings for marine engines and boilersUDC 669.14 - 14 : 629.12MTD 14Reaffirmed 20221 Scope1.1 This standard covers the requirements for steel castings formarine engines and boilers such as boiler mountings, valve chests,machinery castings, etc. It does not cover the requirements forturbine cylinders and associated castings as well as crank shaftsand crank webs.1.2 Notwithstanding what is stated in this specification, therequirements as laid down in the rules for manufacture, testing andcertification of castings of a Classification Society for which aship is being built, which the ship builder specified in hisenquiry and order, are to be complied with, in all respects. Forthis purpose, it is necessary that the purchaser gives the requiredparticulars to the foundry at the time of enquiry and order.2 ReferencesList of referred Indian Standards IS 228: Methodsfor chemical analysis of steelsIS 1500 : 1983Methods for brinell hardness test for metallic materialsIS 1608 : 1972Methods for tensile testing of steel productsIS 1757 : 1973Methods of beam impact test (V-notch) on steelIS 2595 : 1978Code of practice for radiographic testingIS 3658 : 1981Code of practice for liquid penetrant flaw detectionIS 3703 : 1980Code of practice for magnetic particle flaw detectionIS 4897 : 1986Deviations for untoleranced dimensions and mass of steelcastingsIS 5530 : 1986Code of procedure for repair and rectification of steelcastings by metal arc welding processIS 6601 : 1987Permissible deviation in chemical composition forproduct analysis of steel castingsIS 6907 : 1973Methods of sampling of steel castingsIS 7666 : 1975Recommended procedure for ultrasonic examination offerritic castings of carbon and low alloy steelIS 8800 : 1986Technical delivery conditions for steel castingsIS 9565 : 1986Acceptance standards for ultransonic inspection of steelcastingsIS 10724 : 1983Acceptance standards for magnetic particle inspection ofsteel castingsIS 11732 : 1986Acceptance standards for dye penetrant inspection ofsteel castingsIS 12938 : 1990Acceptance standards for radiographic inspection ofsteel castings
